In this paper, we propose a Chunking-Free In-Context (CFIC) retrieval approach aimed at helping the RAG system mitigate information bias introduced by document chunking and irrelevant noisy text. Specifically, given an input query and a long grounding document, instead of refining the long documents with a chunking-based method, we leverage the document's encoded hidden states to perform Chunking-free In-Context Retrieval.
